app.name: Dona Bridge
app.tagline: Manage all your WhatsApp accounts in one place

onboarding.addFirstAccount: Add your first WhatsApp account to get started
onboarding.scanQR: Scan the QR code with WhatsApp on your phone

accounts.selectAccount: Select an account from the sidebar
accounts.groupsHint: Give related accounts a colour ring in the dock. Drag accounts in the dock to reorder them.

settings.title: Settings
settings.startWithWindowsHint: Launch Dona Bridge (minimised to the tray) when you sign in to Windows.
settings.updatesHint: Checks the official release channel. Your data is never sent.
settings.backupHint: A backup contains all accounts, CRM data, templates and settings — not the WhatsApp login sessions. Password is required to restore.
settings.backupPortable: Backups are portable between PCs. After restoring on a new PC, scan the WhatsApp QR code once for each account.
settings.crmJsonHint: Projects, tasks, pinned contacts and theme preferences (stored locally).
settings.accountsHint: Personalize, lock, or mute individual accounts.
settings.apiKeyLabel: API Key (stored in Windows Credential Manager)
settings.aboutCredit: Made by Donatek · Independent project, not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta

lock.title: Dona Bridge is locked
lock.subtitle: Enter your PIN or use Windows Hello to unlock

crm.title: CRM
crm.noContacts: No contacts yet for this account

palette.title: Command palette
palette.hint: Search accounts, contacts, quick replies, projects and actions

copilot.title: AI Copilot
copilot.draftOnly: Draft only — you always press Send
copilot.cloudConsentBody: Sending chat context to a cloud AI provider leaves your PC. Allow cloud AI requests?
copilot.noContext: Click 'Read open chat' to load the last 20 messages in memory.

common.loadFailedBody: Your data was not deleted — it is still on this PC. Dona Bridge could not read its local database, so the account list is hidden instead of showing the setup screen. This is usually temporary (antivirus scan, OneDrive sync, or a database lock).
common.logHint: Details are in the log file:
